page.overview:
Who is Chunky Kong?

Chunky makes a few cameo appearances alongside Diddy Kong and Dixie Kong where they was watching the battle between Mario and Donkey Kong. Chunky was enjoying the matches between the two and even when Mario becomes victorious at the end, Chunky was seen applauding for Mario alongside the other Kongs. He then joins the Kongs in fighting Bowser's army on Rainbow Road.
